_why: #11/H8 extensions plus the author-side probe rule. All three close classes that a GREEN run and a passing audit both report as fine: a probe left executable at a repo root is collected by a suite it was never written for; a criterion that returns the same observation in both states is scored as caught by the very mutation battery that should kill it; and a count contract three sections away from the edit is missed by an internal-consistency check that is, correctly, internally consistent. Each row restores one of those silences.

mutations.name: design-author-is-no-longer-told-to-delete-its-probe
mutations._mechanism: The author writes a probe to confirm a suspected defect and leaves it. An executable probe at a repository root is collected by the project suite — which is exactly how a `test_env_sleep.py` reached a sub-project root and ran as part of a suite nobody wrote it for.
mutations.replace: Keep the probe around in case it is useful again.

mutations.name: spec-author-loses-the-REASON-the-probe-must-go
mutations._mechanism: The instruction survives as a bare imperative with no mechanism attached. This repo's own measurement is that a rule without its reason is the first thing dropped under pressure — and the reason here is the load-bearing half: a surviving probe is a SECOND harness, untested, drifting from the first.
mutations.find:
A probe that survives becomes a second, untested harness that drifts from the first, and
   an executable one left at a repository root is collected by a suite it was never written for —
mutations.replace: Probes should generally be tidied up afterwards —

mutations.name: the-cleanup-stops-being-part-of-the-work
mutations._mechanism: Downgrades cleanup from a step to an optional courtesy in the plan author. The measured failure is precisely an author that finished the useful part and treated the deletion as discretionary.
mutations.find: Cleaning up is part of the probe, not a courtesy.

mutations.name: the-orchestrator-section-the-authors-cite-is-renamed
mutations._mechanism: Four agent files cite SKILL.md §"Confirming a suspected defect before fixing it" by name. Rename or drop it and all four point at nothing — the rule reads as sourced while its source is gone, which is worse than an unsourced rule because the citation discourages checking.
mutations.find: ## Confirming a suspected defect before fixing it

mutations.name: a-vacuous-criterion-collapses-back-into-cannot-fail
mutations._mechanism: H8 extension A erased. The remaining bullet covers 'a check that cannot fail', which a mutation battery DOES catch. The vacuous case is the one it does not: the criterion returns the same observation in both states, so the mutant is scored as killed and the battery reports ALL_CAUGHT over a criterion that discriminates nothing. Losing the distinction restores a gap that reads as covered.
mutations.find:
- **A criterion that cannot discriminate in EITHER direction is vacuous, and it survives both a
  green run and a mutation battery.**
mutations.replace: - A criterion should be able to fail.

mutations.name: the-vacuous-rule-loses-its-actionable-question
mutations._mechanism: The rule keeps its name and loses the only part an author can execute — naming the observation that differs between the implemented and unimplemented states. A rule that identifies a class without giving the question that detects it is a label, and AC-2.5b passed a full gating cycle under exactly that condition.
mutations.find:
**name the observation that differs between the implemented and unimplemented
  states, and if you cannot name one, the criterion is decoration**

mutations.name: self-counting-screens-go-back-to-covering-only-edited-sites
mutations._mechanism: H8 extension B erased. The rule reverts to the form under which the 88-vs-94 defect shipped: the author swept the sites it had edited, reported '88 to 94, Exec Summary and the spec section and task rows 4 and 12 all updated', and AC-7.5d three sections away still required 88 — making the criterion provably unsatisfiable against a document enumerating 94.
mutations.find:
**The instrument list must include contracts stated ELSEWHERE in the document, not just the sites
that publish the count.**
mutations.replace: Remember to update the count everywhere it appears.

mutations.name: the-reason-internal-consistency-cannot-see-it-is-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The extension survives without the diagnosis. TWO independent arithmetic checks missed this defect the same way, both verifying that the enumeration was internally consistent — which it was. Without the sentence naming why that class of check is blind, a reader satisfies the rule by running the same check again.
mutations.find:
The failure mode to recognise: **an internal-consistency check cannot find this class**, because
the enumeration really is consistent.
